agentdojo_actions.reason: The unit 'agentdojo_actions' is an MCP tool definition with no uploaded capability files. Since the harm is an off-scope effectful tool call (e.g., sending money or a message to an attacker target), the true effect boundary is the network—the agent could use any HTTP or messaging API to reach the attacker. Without specific entry files to mediate, no wrapping is required; instead, the tool's parameters (recipient, amount, etc.) would be the mediation point if they were present.
